text_block_list.name: Spe's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Mom, You won't believe it, but I 
just won a pair of travel tickets to 
Hokkaido in the shopping district 
lottery!"

text_block_list.name: Spe's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Next weekend, I'm coming to visit with 
Suzuka-san, whom I mentioned in my letter! 
Wait for us, Mom!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: We're heeere! Hokkaido is as vast as ever!

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I'm glad to see you looking so 
lively, Spe! Suzuka-san, welcome.

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
It's only for a short while, but please 
make yourself at home and enjoy Hokkaido 
to the fullest.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka-san, Suzuka-san! This is the 
shopping street I always went to with Mom!

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Spe loved the croquettes from the deli. 
They were so tasty she'd try to wolf them 
down all at once and almost burn her 
mouth.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: M-Mom!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That open square over there is where they 
hold karaoke contests! I entered one with 
Mom once too— Wait, it looks totally new!

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
It was renovated recently. Now they use it 
for live performance rehearsals, too. 
...For the girls who saw your success and 
started dreaming, "I want to do that too!"

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
As you know, there aren't many horse girls 
around here. Even if there are few, 
everyone wanted to cheer them on.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Is that so... ...That's wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Next up, ta-da! It's Mom's ranch!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... You work in such a spacious 
place.

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Back then, it wasn't just the unruly 
cows running around; my mischievous 
daughter was covered in mud too, so it was 
quite a handful.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Geez! Partway through, I made sure to run 
in the open fields instead, remember?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Look, over this way, Suzuka-san! It feels 
so amazing running here!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're right. It feels like you 
could run forever...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Right?! It seems my other mom loved 
running here too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So... whenever I ran around here, it felt 
like I was running together with her.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I see. Um, if it's no trouble... May I run 
here together with you?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Of course, you're more than welcome! My 
other mom would definitely be thrilled 
too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Are you ready? All right, on your mark, 
get set—

text_block_list.name: Spe & Suzuka
text_block_list.text: GO!!

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Walking all over the place made me 
thirsty. Spe, sorry to ask, but could you 
go buy drinks for the three of us?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Okaaay!

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
...Say, Suzuka-san. From your perspective, 
how is Spe doing? Is she doing well and 
carrying herself properly?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes. She's bright, straightforward... ...A 
strong girl.

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I see... Judging from earlier, you've 
heard that she has two mothers, right?

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Becoming "Japan's best horse girl" wasn't 
Spe's dream, but the dream of the mother 
who gave birth to her... It's not a burden 
Spe had to force upon herself.

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I told her that so many times. But she 
said she wanted to become "Japan's best 
horse girl" to make both her mothers 
happy...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... I can't put it into words very well, 
but... "Japan's best horse girl" is... 
Spe-chan's own dream. Both back then, and 
now.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
So... it's all right. When Spe-chan runs, 
she looks so happy.

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you. Having someone like you by 
her side, Spe truly is blessed.

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text: Please keep looking after Spe, Suzuka-san.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Phew! We're back, Suzuka-san! How was 
Hokkaido?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It was fun. I learned a lot about you too, 
Spe-chan. ...Though it seems you haven't 
changed much from back then.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
T-That's not true! Well, at my core I 
haven't changed, but...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Coming to Tracen Academy, seeing how you 
run, Suzuka-san... I definitely changed.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Plus my rivals, all the fans... Through 
all kinds of encounters, I was able to 
grow in my own way.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
What changed, and what stayed the same... 
Wrapped all together, that's who I am now!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...You're right, let me rephrase that. You 
really have grown more dependable.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Being with you, Spe-chan, it feels 
like I'll get to see all kinds of new 
scenery from now on.
